open_finding: A real lineage must not be claimed until the exact local Ollama model digest is pinned and the model is available. Ambient Claude routing is not acceptable for GROW-0.
resolved_findings: Candidate Python originally executed with normal interpreter privileges and could theoretically read hidden files. The evaluator now permits only a narrow pure formatting AST and executes with empty builtins; a regression test verifies filesystem-reading code is rejected.

Evaluator originally passed the full case object to mutable workshop code, allowing dynamic access to expected_value. It now passes only goal/stored/current evidence; expected fields remain evaluator-private, and AST checks reject direct oracle-key references and candidate input mutation.
